Body.Content:
Azure Network Watcher, now in public preview, simplifies monitoring and diagnosing your Azure virtual network. You can use the diagnostic and visualization tools in Network Watcher to:

  • Take remote packet captures on a virtual machine.
  • Gain insights into network traffic by using flow logs.
  • Diagnose problems with VPN gateways and connections.
  • Help you understand if an IP flow is allowed or denied on a virtual machine.
  • Find where a packet will be routed from a virtual machine.
  • Gain insights into your network topology.

For more information, go to the product page.
